title: Spec File List omits csrf.gleam (the B1 blocker fix), csrf_test.gleam, and reference_form_wiring.test.js — all present in the diff
evidence:
The spec's File List enumerates (consecutive entries, verbatim):
+- `server/src/audit/event_type.gleam` (modified — one variant)
+- `server/src/middleware.gleam` (modified — redact + public-path arms)
+- `server/src/router.gleam` (modified — five route arms)
...with no entry for server/src/auth/csrf.gleam, server/test/auth/csrf_test.gleam, or scripts/js-tests/reference_form_wiring.test.js. Yet the diff contains:
diff --git a/server/src/auth/csrf.gleam b/server/src/auth/csrf.gleam
diff --git a/server/test/auth/csrf_test.gleam b/server/test/auth/csrf_test.gleam
diff --git a/scripts/js-tests/reference_form_wiring.test.js b/scripts/js-tests/reference_form_wiring.test.js
The spec's own Perkins r1 section describes the csrf fix in prose ('Fixed: the arm + docstring + csrf_test pins ...') and W3 names '9 mock-DOM wiring tests', so the work is documented narratively but absent from the enumeration meant to scope review.
detail: The File List is the canonical change enumeration for reviewers. It misses the headline B1 blocker file (csrf.gleam) plus two test files actually in this chunk, contradicting the diff it ships with.
recommended_fix: Add the three missing entries to the spec's File List: server/src/auth/csrf.gleam (modified — skip arm), server/test/auth/csrf_test.gleam (modified — session-cookie pin), scripts/js-tests/reference_form_wiring.test.js (new — 9 wiring tests).
